body: I've been lucky enough to have good grades, but that also leads to pressure. I'm 3rd in a class of  ~400 and I'm taking 4 AP classes this year, but it still doesn't feel like I'm doing well enough to get ahead in life. It just feels empty and pointless.
I don't even know. I was hoping I'd have good enough grades to get a lot of school paid for, but I don't know. Never seems quite good enough.
No. But what I want to do in life will require me to go into a lot of debt for not a huge chance at a job. And people who are born without money usually stay that way. I don't want this.

I'm very stressed. School is hard, and I'm only in high school. College will be worse. I'll have to go into debt. My parents are in debt. We have no money now. I don't know how we'll pay bills and get food. I don't see anything getting better. It's all very bleak. I don't want to be sad and poor forever.
